name: @gatedpath/ops-kit
description: Operations kit for a gated ERC-20 on Redbelly Network: Routescan API scripts (transfers, holders, verified source), a Goldsky subgraph template, an alert poller that posts pause, forced transfer, role and verifier changes to a webhook, a watcher for the network's own system contracts (registry answers, the permission proxy's implementation, admin and roles), an RPC fallback helper across governors, Ankr and Uniblock, and an incident runbook with a filled-in example. Read-only; no key.

scripts.prepack: node --check src/index.mjs && node --check src/cli.mjs && node --check scripts/alert.mjs && node --check scripts/system-watch.mjs
